note: Mission 3 'The Signet in the Sighing Wood' in-game lines (M3.VO1 renders them). dur = slot in seconds. Line ids keep the ep1 numbering (L9 unused; L20 only with Pell; L22 new). Speakers: narrator, vessa, whisper, pell, bettany, ysolde, maelis, malrik, obren (alias of whisper, shown as Obren from L15). New in mission lines: bettany, ysolde, maelis, obren. Cutscene lines (m3_plea / m3_memory / m3_parting) live in Mission03.CINE_LINES.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Sighing Wood has kept out of every quarrel for a hundred years. Today two armies walked in.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik's already here. Of course he is. Then I'll borrow a forest.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: The third one sleeps in the old tree. Wake it before he does.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: A war! Terrible. Wonderful for business. Terrible.

lines.speaker: bettany
lines.text: The Crooked Lantern is open! Sellswords, cheap ale, no questions. First hire's on the house.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Sellswords who won't take orders. Perfect. I'll pay them to want what I want.

lines.speaker: bettany
lines.text: Mind the flags, Firelady. Coin on a flag is the only order that lot understands.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A heart made of roots, pumping green. Only Ysolde would grow a thing like that.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: His Thralls are draining the hearts. If he opens that tree first, I lose it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Fire and Shadow, burning my wood for a trinket. I will remember you both.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Old Mossjaw wakes in the Hollowfen, and he is hungry.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Somebody tell the sellswords their bounty's ready. And tell the bear I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.text: Turn back, fire-child. The wolves already have your scent.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Stop, both of you! You don't know what you're opening!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A tree. I'm opening a tree. Before HE does.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Mine. Thank you for the escort, little ember.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Dropped something, Bishop? Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: Three. Thank you, little ember. I'll take it from here.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Rubble with eyes. Your mess, Vessa. I'll be at my camp, enjoying the view.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One gate down. Stone breaks. Good to know.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Tell Malrik... he still dresses like a funeral.
